notes:
Fixes the packaging bug in 0.4.0.

`Scripts/bundle.sh` still installed OpenTofu to `~/.codex/codex-remote/tofu`, the pre-0.4.0 location. On a machine that builds from source that recreated the directory 0.4.0 had just migrated away from, and put the bundled OpenTofu somewhere the app no longer looks.

Only affects building from source — installed copies fetch and verify OpenTofu themselves on first use — but it meant the 0.4.0 migration did not stay done.
